Wholesale funding and shadow-asset complexity are strategy/risk dimensions rather than a second period-wide rural-bank model; provincial-union support and recognition changes are cross-cutting mechanisms; village banks remain a smaller sponsor-led parallel lineage; internet/digital deposits are an emerging funding technique rather than a new lineage.

known_major_gaps: BANK-RURAL 1990-1994 through 2017-2019 are broad+orthogonal complete. TIME-2020-2022 is the next unopened primary slice.

The 2020-2022 broad challenge should recover pandemic relief/forbearance and delayed asset-quality recognition; agriculture, household, micro/SME and county-economy stress; property-downturn and local-government spillovers; small/village-bank governance, fraud, related-party and depositor-confidence risks including the remembered Henan village-bank episode without inventing actors/dates/amounts or confusing village banks with RCC/RCB lineage; internet/platform-deposit restrictions and liability competition; NIM/margin pressure; WMP/net-value transition; digital-channel acceleration; provincial-union liquidity/governance and early consolidation signals; capital/NPL/overdue/restructuring semantics and regional counterexamples.
